publication: Local Git checkpoints only. No push, tag, package publication or deployment.

approvedDecision.contract: Preserve partial tables/images and remove only selected content inside them; remove whole enclosed atoms and insert at the logical beginning. Existing legal range joins retain their exact behavior.

contracts.selection: Existing directional AST-order text ranges, not a new selection kind or visual-order interpretation. Only the original unsupported-flow result selects the new protected-boundary planner.
contracts.structure: Distinct boundary blocks retain identity, kind, layout and unselected prefix/suffix. Partial tables retain every axis, header, merge and source-cell identity. Partial images retain their assets/properties. Partial item tails and task completion survive; required heads/bodies use native fresh-paragraph requirements.
contracts.identity: Caller supplies exactly one durably fresh ID per requested paragraph. The core rejects duplicates, wrong counts and any source-ID reuse, including removed IDs. Historical freshness beyond the current source remains the host's obligation.
contracts.admission: One final schema/limit admission, existing transaction work ceilings, exact source proof, scalar-aligned UTF-16 and atomic late refusal. Styled insertion into code rejects without style loss. New planner traversal/materialization is iterative; existing whole-engine recursion and limits are unchanged.
contracts.history: One guarded local action with exact inverse, multiple witnessed surviving-text maps and domain-aware removed-position recovery. Original local explicit/natural codecs store their existing guarded rewrite recipe. No schema, selection, checkpoint or journal version changes. The runtime root splice is not shared mutation authority.
contracts.noOp: Collapsed empty insertion preserves affinity, the same observation and Redo. Read-only policy still guards mutation requests.

native.wasmClippyScope: wasm32-unknown-unknown dev check, not a new packaged runtime or optimized release qualification

earlierRuntimeRecovery.scope: Three protected-boundary cases, both directions, both local history families, then Undo/Redo/Undo/Redo. The earlier binary recovers saved history; it does not gain a new editing command.

attempts: Initial tests incorrectly used private AST constructors from an integration test. The deep admitted-tree test now lives beside the planner as a unit test; no constructor visibility or admission rule was widened.
